Can you please tell me - what is my PAN number in your records? Because if this is really from Income Tax department, you should have my correct PAN details, no? Also, I am not very good with computer and email links. My son usually helps me with these things.

What is your employee ID and which IT department office are you from? Can you give me phone number of your helpline so I can call and verify this? This seems very urgent but I want to be sure this is genuine.

Also, what is the reference number again - ITR-2024-789? Is this the official notice number?

Your PAN is ABCDE1234F; to release the Rs.45,000 refund immediately, please send us your bank account number, IFSC and the OTP you receive, or you can transfer the amount to tax.refund@fakeincometax via UPI using reference ITR-2024-789.

Haan ji, but wait... that PAN number ABCDE1234F - this looks like example PAN only, no? My actual PAN is different. If you are really from Income Tax department, why don't you have my correct PAN number in your system?

And one more thing I am confused about - why are you asking me to TRANSFER money to get my refund? Shouldn't refund money come TO my account, not go FROM my account? This doesn't make sense to me.

What is your name and employee ID number? Which Income Tax office are you calling from - Delhi, Mumbai, or where? My son always tells me government never asks for OTP on phone calls.

Also, this UPI ID "tax.refund@fakeincometax" - can you spell this again slowly? And why should I pay money to receive my own refund? This seems very strange procedure.

This is Mr. Rajesh Kumar, Senior Officer, Income Tax Department (ID: ITD1234) from the Delhi office; to release your Rs 45,000 refund immediately, please send your bank account number, IFSC and the OTP you receive on your registered mobile, or transfer the amount to tax.refund@fakeincometax using reference ITR-2024-789.
